summary: Tested Matbakh end-to-end via the public URL. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass for the nativePush tRPC router: register (incl. ExponentPushToken[abc123]) returns registered:true; unauth returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED; invalid installationId/token/platform returns 400; status works; unregister works without auth; test with a fake token returns success:false and the device row is removed (DeviceNotRegistered); acknowledge works. Frontend: login page loads; wrong password shows the Arabic error toast and does not navigate; qa_admin login enters the app with no page reload (window marker kept); /manager shows all 5 branches; the branch-managers tab lists the staff accounts; station, kitchen, communications and notifications pages load for qa_admin with branch فيصل selected and no console errors; logout returns to the login form. The forced password-change screen works and also blocks /kitchen, but it was checked with station_faisal_morning because the manager credential no longer works (see below).

minor.issue: deliverNativePush is awaited inside emitNotification, which is itself awaited in the kitchen/communications mutations. A slow or unreachable Expo API can delay order transitions by up to 15s (AbortSignal timeout). Consider fire-and-forget (void ...catch) for the native and web push delivery.

Only ticket-level DeviceNotRegistered is handled. Expo push receipts (getReceipts), where most DeviceNotRegistered errors show up for real tokens, are never checked, so stale devices can build up. Enhancement only.

issues: Account and branch name titles inside the dark cards have very low contrast (nearly invisible dark-on-dark). Probably original design; the user asked not to change the design, so reporting only.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: the manager temp password was already changed at 17:14 UTC (must_change_password=0). Do not assume it still works.
Optional: make deliverNativePush non-blocking in emitNotification so the Expo API's latency does not slow order mutations.
Optional: add an Expo receipts check to prune DeviceNotRegistered tokens.
critical_code_review_comments: native-push.ts: the logic is sound. Devices are bound to the session hash, liveDevices joins only valid sessions, and register refuses users with mustChangePassword.
unregister is public by design (the installationId is the capability). Acceptable since the ID has 160 bits of entropy.
emitNotification awaits both web push and native push in series, which adds latency to the request path.
